flagged.title: CORRECTED: day-1 9z–Aurora Nuke map score (13-1, not 13-4)
flagged.detail: The day-4 desk's first published table read 'Nuke 13-4'. Every retained capture in this repository that records the map carries 13-1 for 9z, and 13-4 is the day-3 *Inferno* score on the same table — the two were transposed. Corrected in scripts/1c8f79f8/research.py, on day4/twc-review.html and on day4/flagged.html. Map results are editorial context: no published probability derives from them.

flagged.title: Aurora 'recent roster change' premise could not be verified for October 2026
flagged.detail: The premise handed to this project ('there was a recent roster change for Aurora') is not supported by any source checked: HLTV's team timeline, Liquipedia, egamersworld lineups and the Oct-5 Valve VRS row all show the same five, with the last verified change being the July 2026 rebuild (Jimpphat + coach ash on 3 July, captain kyxsan on 8 July). What *is* recent is the onboarding: a new IGL and three new players were still bedding in at the day-1 9z loss, and the day-3 2-0 avenge (kyxsan 1.45) is the onboarding-complete signal. The pick is based on that timeline, not on a phantom October move.

flagged.title: Two boards reproduce with different Glicko rating deviations (RD=75 vs RD=200)
flagged.detail: Every originated model line re-derives, but not from the same constant: the canonical board, the day-4 desk, the full-coverage board and the 'our-line' board reproduce with RD = 75 (the value in scripts/fe803b80/core.py), while the exec board reproduces only with RD = 200. The two give visibly different lines for the same rating pair (e.g. a 137-point gap is 54.4% at RD=200 and 54.8% at RD=75 before the k fit). Both are labelled 'Valve's Glicko constants' on their own method pages, so the divergence is published rather than silently merged. Concrete per-board evidence: picks-every-match (canonical): RD=75.0; day-4 desk (TWC + every open match): RD=75.0; full-coverage board: RD=75.0; our-line board: RD=75.0; exec board: RD=200.0. This session did not change either board's numbers.
